recovered_load_bearing_semantics.limitation: Direct E8(-24) mirror-fermion predictions face the negative observation that mirrors are not known to occur. The model would have to explain sufficiently large mirror masses or another consistent realization.
recovered_load_bearing_semantics.asserted_scalar_coupling: In the author's direct interpretation E8(-24) also predicts axions and additional Higgs scalars, which are said to interact with the mirror fermions.
recovered_load_bearing_semantics.conditional_generation_hypothesis: The author proposes that such scalars COULD help explain the three repeated fermion generations and their masses, POSSIBLY by scalar-fermion composite structures; no model, dynamics or mass theorem is supplied for such composites.
recovered_load_bearing_semantics.separate_E8_split_hint: Embedding the Standard Model algebra in split E8(8) through Pati-Salam is introduced as another POSSIBLE generation-related hint, expressly undeveloped. It does not replace the frozen quaternionic E8(-24) construction.
recovered_load_bearing_semantics.explicit_open_questions: Generation multiplicity, particle and mirror masses, a complete action and ultimate quantum description are all left OPEN by the author.
recovered_load_bearing_semantics.negative_direct_identification_separate: The earlier three-block triality split of 64 SM fermions, 64 mirrors and 64 non-SM bosons is NOT directly three physical generations; the scalar-composite possibility is later a distinct speculative mechanism, not a reversal of this source correction.
